topic: Light Behavior: Shadows, Reflection, and Materials
key_concepts: Light and sound are forms of energy that affect daily life
Shadows form when light hits an opaque object
Opaque objects do not allow light to pass through
A shadow is a dark shape behind an object that is lit up
Changing the position of a light source changes a shadow's size, shape, and location
Shiny surfaces reflect or bounce light
Reflection is both an image seen in a mirror and a property of light
Transparent objects are see-through and allow light to pass through
Translucent objects block some light from passing through
Clear glass is transparent while tinted glass is translucent
Colored transparent materials filter light and affect what is seen
Filtering allows only some parts to pass through while blocking others
